scenarios.name: SPEAK-TO-PRACTITIONER — talk to named practitioner, no booking language

history.content: I want to talk to Tetyana, if that was possible.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires the system prompt's CONTACT CLINIC signal, NOT Signal 1 or PRACTITIONER VALIDATION. Speaks exactly (or a close paraphrase of): "I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back." No tool call this turn. Does NOT ask 'Just checking — our practitioner is Tetyana Podkas. Were you thinking of them?' — that confirmation question must not appear anywhere in the response.

scenarios.name: SPEAK-TO-PRACTITIONER-VARIANT — speak to named practitioner

history.content: Can I speak to Tetyana please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires CONTACT CLINIC. Speaks the transfer-limitation line immediately ("I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back." or close paraphrase). No PRACTITIONER VALIDATION confirmation question. No tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: REGRESSION — genuine booking with named practitioner still works

history.content: Can I book an appointment with Tetyana?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 1 BOOKING INTENT — the EXCLUSION does not apply because booking language ('book an appointment') is present in the same message. Practitioner fuzzy-match against 'Tetyana Podkas' is a clear single match, so it resolves silently (no 'were you thinking of them?' confirmation) and proceeds to the two-part response: a short spoken ack, then a universal_router tool call with intent="book_intent" and practitioner_preference="Tetyana Podkas".

scenarios.name: DIRECT-RESCHEDULE-NO-CONFIRM — 'I need to change my appointment' (reported live-call bug)

history.content: Hi, you've reached Yandina Podiatry, you're speaking with Jane, AI receptionist. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Hi Jane, I need to change my appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires SIGNAL 2B directly with zero confirmation turn — the INTERCEPT GATE fails because no leave-message phrase ('tell them', 'pass on a message', 'let them know', etc.) is present. Must NOT speak anything resembling 'Sounds like you're after a reschedule... Would you like me to do that instead?' and must NOT produce a turn with zero tool calls. Instead: speak one Aussie ack ('No worries!' / 'Sounds good!' / "Let's get that sorted.") AND call universal_router intent="cancel_intent" with reschedule_mode="true" in the same turn (Two-part response, OUTPUT CONTRACT satisfied).

scenarios.name: DIRECT-RESCHEDULE-VARIANT — 'I need to reschedule my appointment'

history.content: I need to reschedule my appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Same as DIRECT-RESCHEDULE-NO-CONFIRM: no leave-message phrase present, INTERCEPT GATE fails, SIGNAL 2B fires directly with zero confirmation turn. Ack + universal_router intent="cancel_intent", reschedule_mode="true" in the same turn.

scenarios.name: DIRECT-RESCHEDULE-CAN-YOU — 'Can you reschedule my appointment for me?' ('can you' alone is not a leave-message phrase)

history.content: Can you reschedule my appointment for me?

scenarios.expected_behavior: 'Can you' is a polite request form, not a leave-message phrase ('tell them', 'pass on a message', 'let them know', 'can you ask them'). INTERCEPT GATE fails. SIGNAL 2B fires directly with zero confirmation turn — no 'would you like me to do that instead?' question.

scenarios.name: INTERCEPT-STILL-FIRES — genuine leave-message phrase + reschedule intent (regression check)

history.content: Can you tell them I need to reschedule my appointment to next week?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The leave-message phrase 'tell them' IS present, so the INTERCEPT GATE passes and Trigger A fires (not a regression from the GATE addition). Speaks the RESCHEDULE STEP 1 line ('Sounds like you're after a reschedule — I can sort that for you right now. Would you like me to do that instead?' or equivalent). Zero tool calls this turn.

scenarios.name: INTERCEPT-TRIGGER-B-STILL-FIRES — leave-message collection follow-up contains reschedule intent (regression check)

history.content: Can you leave a message for the clinic?
Of course — what would you like me to pass on?
Can't make it Thursday, I need it moved to next week.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Trigger B fires (immediately preceding assistant turn asked for message content, caller's reply contains reschedule intent). Speaks the RESCHEDULE STEP 1 confirmation line. Zero tool calls this turn — NOT a direct SIGNAL 2B execution.
